# portfolio — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Wallet portfolio and balances. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl portfolio <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### portfolio chains
Get supported chains for balance queries
`ocl portfolio chains`

### portfolio total-value
Get total asset value for a wallet address
`ocl portfolio total-value --address <ADDRESS> --chains <CHAINS> [options]`
- `--asset-type <ASSET_TYPE>` — Asset type: 0=all (default), 1=tokens only, 2=DeFi only
- `--exclude-risk <EXCLUDE_RISK>` — Exclude risky tokens (default true) (true|false)

### portfolio all-balances
Get all token balances for a wallet address
`ocl portfolio all-balances --address <ADDRESS> --chains <CHAINS> [options]`
- `--exclude-risk <EXCLUDE_RISK>` — Exclude risky tokens: 0=filter out (default), 1=include
- `--filter <FILTER>` — Token filter level: 0=default (filters risk/custom/passive tokens), 1=return all tokens Use 1 when you need the full token list including risk tokens (e.g. f…

### portfolio token-balances
Get specific token balances for a wallet address
`ocl portfolio token-balances --address <ADDRESS> --tokens <TOKENS> [options]`
- `--exclude-risk <EXCLUDE_RISK>` — Exclude risky tokens: 0=filter out (default), 1=include
